title: Aubergine & Peanut Curry with Lime Rice
ingredients: 2 aubergines (~700g total), chopped into small chunks
For the rice: 300g white basmati rice, finely grated zest and juice of 1 unwaxed lime, finely chopped coriander
steps: In a sauté pan, fry aubergines and peppers in cooking spray over gentle heat for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Blend sauce: peanut butter, soy sauce, rice vinegar, red chilli, garlic and sweet chilli sauce in a mini chopper until smooth.
Add sauce to pan; stir well; top up with boiling water. Simmer 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, adding more water if too dry.
Halfway through curry cooking time, cook basmati rice per package instructions.
When rice is cooked, drain; stir in lime zest and juice and chopped coriander.
Dry-fry/toast crushed peanuts in a small pan until golden. Serve curry over rice; scatter with toasted peanuts.
notes: Swap white rice for brown basmati for more chew — follow package instructions for longer cooking time.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
